gallery.filename: 66th Annual National Guard Association of Georgia and Georgia Enlisted Association Conference (14220786309).jpg
gallery.title: File:66th Annual National Guard Association of Georgia and Georgia Enlisted Association Conference (14220786309).jpg
gallery.artist: Georgia National Guard from United States
gallery.description: STONE MOUNTAIN PARK, Stone Mountain, Georgia, June 8, 2014 - The 66th Annual Conference of the National Guard Association of Georgia and Georgia Enlisted Association (EANGGA) Conference took place June 6-8 2014 at the Stone Mountain Marriott Evergreen Conference Center and Resort. Conference activities included golfing, professional and business development seminars. The conference's concluded with a formal dinner with dancing and award ceremony. "The joint session of officers and enlisted allows us to come together and address important issues that are critical to our growth as a force," Major Gen. Jim Butterworth, the Adjutant General of the Georgia National Guard said of this years conference. (Georgia National Guard photo by Staff Sgt. Tracy J. Smith)

gallery.filename: Maj. Gen. Butterworth speaks with Guardsmen (14384303516).jpg
gallery.title: File:Maj. Gen. Butterworth speaks with Guardsmen (14384303516).jpg
gallery.artist: Georgia National Guard from United States
gallery.description: STONE MOUNTAIN PARK, Stone Mountain, Georgia, June 8, 2014 – Major Gen. Jim Butterworth, the Adjutant General of the Georgia National Guard spoke candidly with Georgia Soldiers of the Warrant Officer Corps during the 66th Annual Conference of the National Guard Association of Georgia and Georgia Enlisted Association (EANGGA) Conference June 6-8 2014 at the Stone Mountain Marriott Evergreen Conference Center and Resort. “You are OUR go-to experts, a specific entity of professionals we have tremendous confidence in,” Butterworth said of the men and women he calls “the finest of the best.” The three-day conference offered a fun agenda of golfing, dining and dancing but was punctuated with opportunities for professional and business development through seminars. The Airmen and Soldiers of Georgia were also able to hear from leadership from the National Guard Bureau and Georgia 7th District Congressman, Rob Woodall. (Georgia National Guard photo by Staff Sgt. Tracy J. Smith)

gallery.title: File:New Association officers sworn in (14406311464).jpg
gallery.artist: Georgia National Guard from United States
gallery.description: STONE MOUNTAIN PARK, Stone Mountain, Georgia, June 8, 2014 - Newly elected officers for the Georgia Enlisted National Guard Association (EANGGA) take the allegiance to lead with honor and integrity during the 66th Annual Conference of the National Guard Association of Georgia and Georgia Enlisted Association (EANGGA) Joint Conference June 6-8, 2014 at the Stone Mountain Marriott Evergreen Conference Center and Resort. As an example of modern military unity, the combined officer – enlisted conference not only ushered in new officers but reiterated the principles of professionalism and mentorship. "The joint session of officers and enlisted allows us to come together and address important issues that are critical to our growth as a force," Major Gen. Jim Butterworth, the Adjutant General of the Georgia National Guard said of this years conference. (Georgia National Guard photo by Staff Sgt. Tracy J. Smith)

gallery.description: STONE MOUNTAIN PARK, Stone Mountain, Georgia, June 8, 2014 - The outgoing president for the National Guard Association of Georgia, Lt. Col. gallery.title: File:Let Us Pray (35075226166).jpg
gallery.artist: Georgia National Guard from United States
gallery.description:
STONE MOUNTAIN PARK, Stone Mountain, Georgia, June 4, 2017 - The 69th Annual Conference of the Enlisted Association of the National Guard of Georgia (EANGGA) and the National Guard Association of Georgia took place June 2-4 2017 at the Stone Mountain Marriott Evergreen Conference Center and Resort. During the event, members received strategic leadership presentations from Gen. Joseph Lengyel Chief, National Guard Bureau, Lt. Gen Gary H. Cheek, Director, Army Staff and Maj. Gen. James K. Brown Jr., Deputy Commanding General (RC). Conference activities included golfing, professional and business development seminars. The conferences concluded with a formal dinner with dancing and award ceremony which included, officers being presented with the Terrell J. Reddick Leadership Award.

Georgia National Guard photo by 1st Sgt. Gerard Brown
